caveats: ⚑ skill1 step 1 'Potency of HP ▲ 30.96%' is mapped to targetMaxHpPct as the literal reading; if it is a healing-POTENCY (recovery-amount) stat the schema has no key for it. Either way the step is offensively INERT — it is retained so the escalating step INDEX is correct (dropping it would make the Distributed Damage step fire on the FIRST Full Burst instead of the second).

⚑ skill1 block 2 'an ally from the same squad' is gated via teamHas.slugs with an UNVERIFIED squad roster (see flags). Wrong slugs make the block inert = under-credit, deliberately chosen over an ungated block that would over-fire teammates' on-recovery triggers (e.g. crown in the control comp).

Both heal effects carry NO HP amount (the engine models no HP pool). Their only live consequence is emitting recovery events to all allies, which drives on-recovery consumers; the 3.04%/40.18% Max-HP magnitudes are recorded here only.
'Three times: Stack count of debuffs ▼ 1' is a cleanse with no v1 consumer — omitted from the escalating steps array (escalating applies steps 1..N, so a 2-step array is correct behaviour at N=3).
noFb is not applicable to this kit: it contains ZERO damage effects (no flatDamage/dot/storedHit). Nothing here takes or is exempt from the Full-Burst major.
The escalating counters are per-block and independent (skill1 counts Full-Burst ENTRIES, skill2 counts Full-Burst ENDS); neither is stated to reset, so both are treated as monotonic for the fight.
Burst is keyed burstCast (her own cast), so its ATK buff lands PRE-Full-Burst — correct per trigger fidelity for a Burst II self-slot block, and it must not be re-keyed to fullBurstEnter.
note: PARSER BASELINE (HYPOTHESIS — NOT a validated model). Every ⚑ below is an UNMEASURED estimate; hand-tune + record against a real fight before trusting any number.
